typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DaysBackFromLastRun as integer (),
	LAST_RUN_DATE as timestamp (),
	RecordCount as integer (),
	StagingDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		MEMBER_NUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '',
	schemaName: '',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(CodeType = 'INFOSCREEN') ~> AddCodeType
AddCodeType derive(xMemberNumber = MEMBER_NUMBER,
		xCodeType = CodeType) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER = xMemberNumber,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE = xCodeType)) ~> PDSOBMEMEMBERCODESSTAGING
